trophies.guide: This is the reward for the other 54 trophies, so there is no shortcut to it: finish the story, work through the side strands, robberies, activities and collectibles, then complete the 100% checklist. Guides put the whole run at roughly 200 to 300 hours, with no online, difficulty or mission-medal trophies in the way. Keep cheats off your trophy save, since they switch trophies and saving off.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy, so it unlocks naturally in the first hour. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks, usually as the next chapter begins. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 is over. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter as insurance.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 to unlock it. By now Jason and Lucia are both playable, so most of the open-world list opens up from here. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The Chapter 3 race against Yago is time-sensitive (it shows an hourglass icon) and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so save first and race it the moment it appears. The trophy itself unlocks when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies unlock near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, so take that mission when it appears. Keep a manual save from the chapter start.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and the trophy pops. Before you start it, make an untouched manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so this save is your way back. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely and the 100% checklist appears.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Right after it, switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, and you can call the other one in as your partner — the partner trophies need that. It unlocks automatically as you play the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story, so there is nothing extra to do. Keep playing and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. No preparation and no way to miss it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. Just keep playing through the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. The airport itself matters later for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. One of the last story-mission trophies before the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The thresholds are lenient: 300 of the 397 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges and 200 of the 277 vehicle models are enough. Anything you did before the credits still counts, so most of it is done by the time the story ends.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The game has 397 in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, so you only need a little over half. Find them on the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side pursuits — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games and the rest — so sampling each one pops the trophy early. Check the Activities tab on your map to see which types you have not tried yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows.
trophies.name: The Shootist

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so keep some cash on hand. Find the locations under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones, and win at least one race at each spot.
trophies.name: Top Fun

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The same race won twice does not count, so work through the race locations as you explore Leonida and track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car; watch your car's Rating, which you can raise with upgrades from Mod Shops.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg: fish in the area marked on your map until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod, but there are plenty around to hijack if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end. Arcade machines are scattered around Leonida's bars and arcades.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy by finishing all of Andy's story missions. The strand runs through the side missions, so follow Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map. The trophy pops when his last mission ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, the mission named Maritime Disputes. Finish Kenton's strand and the trophy pops when that mission ends. Kenton's missions are part of the side stories you meet while exploring Leonida.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the mission named Hometown Heroes. Finish Billy's strand and the trophy pops when that mission ends. Billy's missions are side content, so they stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand race in Chapter 3, Race Against Yago, is time-sensitive, so save first and race it when it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by finishing all of Randy's missions. Randy's strand involves his wish-list vehicles, so expect to track down specific cars around Leonida. The trophy pops when his last mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone by finishing all of Tyrone's missions. His strand sends you to Kitty Litter Lab locations around the map, so use a location list to work through them. The trophy pops when his last mission ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — and do the Chapter 1 one first. After Lucia is home, she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate in the morning; follow her and accept the optional task, because it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. Take a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, so any 3 full sets will do; if you are going for 100% completion you will need 15 sets anyway. Track progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards, and note that cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward your sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up) to scan 100 locations. Scannable landmarks include 31 WAiNK landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than enough to reach 100. Check progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game — in-game feats listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges — and you need 50 of them for this trophy. Many complete on their own while you play, and 70 are needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone — getting out of the flashing search area is not enough.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. You discover a vehicle automatically when you get inside one or when you scan one, so it should happen naturally through the story. Track what you have found under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, use an assault rifle, and note that Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport — the trophy is delayed and pops then. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and if someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and escaping with a 4-star Wanted Level also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run their routes around Leonida; hit one, grab the cash and get away. Like the other robbery trophies, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map — Vice City, the coast, the islands and the interior — until the map is filled in. The far corners and small islands are the ones most often left unvisited, so sweep them last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

source.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts marked around the map; hit one for each gang and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so it pops along the way if you are going for the platinum.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed method is published at launch, but the description is the lead: order a drink at a bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view. Try the beachfront bars and stay for the animation to finish.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed method is published at launch; the description points to driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front, the classic-style exit. Pick a showroom, build a little speed inside, and drive out through the front.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police; if you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: Jason and Lucia both need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Keep working out together until both of you are maxed and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the counter, so it fills up without a separate grind as you play through the game's criminal life. Check your Criminal Profile in the Progress menu to watch the count climb.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method is published at launch; the name points to succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing it once. If a stunt, race or challenge fails, try it again right away — the retry is the likely trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed method is published at launch; the description points to witnessing something strange — an easter egg or unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained while you explore, especially at night and off the beaten path.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed method is published at launch; the name and description point to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon. Line up a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy should follow.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Simply go to any shop and spend your money — the total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so clothes, weapons, food and cars all count. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad, Style.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, for $160,000 in total. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up): Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000 and Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each adds one parking spot for registered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
